title: WOLFKM-2ff impl: FIPS provider priority (A) + REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl (B)
description: Implement both options: (A) FIPS-gated providers always outrank non-FIPS in registry dispatch — load order safe; (B) CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS per-fd ioctl that makes INIT return -ENOENT if only non-FIPS provider available. Also add pr_warn on load-order FIPS bypass.
close_reason: Implemented Option A (two-pass FIPS-first lookup in registry, informative collision warnings) + Option B (REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl slot 20, require_fips flag in fd_state, INIT rejects non-FIPS provider with -ENOENT if flag set)
